difference: This is the exact root-word proposal, not the full additive order. The n^4+36 sum family escapes the word-only restriction and is not refuted by it.
label: root-words-prime-clock
next_test: Apply Q(A)^2-4nu(A)>=0 and Gaussian integrality; test a three-unitary sum as a deliberately out-of-scope positive control.
object: Attempt to generate a non-unit arithmetic label nu(A)>1 using only finite matrix products of roots A in the marked maximal Gaussian E8 order M, where Q(A)=Tr(AA*)=2 and nu(A)=|det A|^2; no addition, scalar weighting or extra generators.
obligations: Exhibit a product of the stipulated roots whose arithmetic norm exceeds one
scope: All finite product lengths of exactly these Q=2 roots. Target here is the prerequisite nu>1, not a claim that resolving it would prove RH. Coherent sums and other generators are excluded from this scope.
stop_condition: Reject this product-only prerequisite if nu is always 0 or 1; do not transfer rejection to coherent addition.
